description: Set an existing signature request deadline with an ISO 8601 date or date-time at least one hour in the future, or remove it with expires_at: null. A shorter deadline ends signing when it passes; Assinafy refuses expired or closed requests.

expires_at.description: new ISO 8601 expiry, or null to remove the expiration

name: assinafy_set_assignment_expiration
title: Change the deadline
